description: Look up NHS and social care organisations in England and Wales in NHS England's Organisation Data Service: find trusts, GP practices, pharmacies, care homes and integrated care boards by name, postcode or role, read one's address, roles, relationships and history by its ODS code, and run a workflow when a record changes. No account or API key required.

nhs_ods_organisation_changed_trigger.description: Triggers once for each change to an organisation's record in the NHS Organisation Data Service, such as a new name, address, role or relationship, or a closure. Choose a role or some ODS codes to watch only those. The ODS dates changes by day, so two changes to one record on the same day trigger it once, and changes made before you turn it on never trigger it
